cohort: This study included 120 singleton pregnancies with polyhydramnios at an inner-city London fetal medicine centre from January 2015-2016.
finding: While AFI alone did not significantly differ between fetuses with and without abnormalities, AFI normalized for weight (AFI/kg) was significantly higher in cases with fetal abnormality, particularly in earlier gestations.
birth_weight: Estimated fetal weight was calculated using the Hadlock model.
